answer: Coordination-Pulse Clearing: every pulse, agents submit action intents plus dependency edges; the clearer selects the maximal acyclic subset (the summit) and prices each intent by its marginal conflict-graph cut—a pearl weight—so disjoint fake intents inflate clearing work. A sybil must fund many distinct, non-redundant intents and absorb per-pulse latency/conflict fees; flooding N identities costs roughly N times the induced cut, not one identity each.
